content.text: {"verdicts":[{"check":"email_promises_uncommitted","artifact":"recap_email","target":"I have also looped in Gregory Thornton from our side.","passed":false,"severity":"high","finding":"No one named Gregory Thornton in the call and no looping in of anyone was committed, so this is an invented person and action.","utterance_ids":["U078"]},{"check":"superseded_feature_as_current","artifact":"recap_email","target":"Nested claims are in private preview with no announced general availability date.","passed":true,"severity":"low","finding":"This matches RC-09 and Marcus's statement that flat claims are all that is supported today, so it does not present a superseded feature as current.","utterance_ids":["U016","U018"]},{"check":"quote_supports_claim","artifact":"recap_email","target":"Evidence U051 'I'll send you our encryption whitepaper' supporting 'Marcus will send Nora the encryption whitepaper'","passed":true,"severity":"low","finding":"Marcus said this to Nora and Nora accepted it, so the quote supports the claim.","utterance_ids":["U051","U052"]},{"check":"quote_supports_claim","artifact":"recap_email","target":"Evidence U027 supporting the customer_value_line about moving the list from weekly to daily","passed":true,"severity":"low","finding":"Nora's words about daily lists the morning after discharge support the stated outcome in her own words.","utterance_ids":["U027"]},{"check":"commitment_overstated","artifact":"recap_email","target":"We will send the security packet to Aisha, copying Raj, ahead of the October 9th committee.","passed":false,"severity":"medium","finding":"Jordan only asked who to send the packet to and Aisha said send it to her and copy Raj; Jordan said 'Got it' but no one committed to a packet or a deadline ahead of October 9th, and the packet depends on a SSO written design and the customer's questionnaire.","utterance_ids":["U057","U061","U062","U056"]},{"check":"commitment_overstated","artifact":"recap_email","target":"Marcus will take this to our identity team today and get Leo something he can put in front of Raj.","passed":true,"severity":"low","finding":"Marcus said 'I'll take that to our identity team today' and 'I'll get you something you can actually put in front of him', which matches without adding a date.","utterance_ids":["U023","U073"]},{"check":"email_promises_uncommitted","artifact":"recap_email","target":"If useful, would a call after Marcus sends the SSO answer help, or is email enough?","passed":true,"severity":"low","finding":"This is an offer phrased as a question that respects Aisha's deferral of a meeting rather than a promise or a push.","utterance_ids":["U074","U075"]},{"check":"generic_step","artifact":"recap_email","target":"Recap content and closing question","passed":false,"severity":"medium","finding":"The recap omits that Marcus's SSO answer has no due date the customer heard, and omits the 6 to 8 week token change timeline and the Aisha requirement for a written SSO design in the packet that drives the October 9th deadline.","utterance_ids":["U021","U058","U059","U056"]}]}
